assumptions: risk gate: none. NO RISK ENGINE: every signal was traded as the strategy sized it (Phase 11 is not built); position limits, loss limits and exposure caps were not applied
no margin or funds check: the account is never short of cash
orders are priced by a minimal marketable-limit stand-in (limit_buffer_bps from the config, tick-rounded); Phase 12 owns the real execution pricing
intraday: resting orders are cancelled and positions exited from session.square_off_at; anything still open at the session's close is closed by the broker's forced square-off
fills: through crossing, at the order's own limit, 0.1 of bar volume, 0 bps rejected (seed 0), forced square-off 10 bps against
fee schedule NOT reconciled against a contract note (verified: false)
146 trading day(s) predate the oldest fee schedule and were priced with it

universe: 2 of 2 instrument(s) were resolved from their EARLIEST recorded definition, because the instrument master holds no history covering 2025-09-22; a delisting or symbol change before the master began recording is not represented (survivorship, EM-99 H8)

conventions.returns: daily, from end-of-day equity; fractions, not percent
conventions.cagr_years: calendar days first to last trading day inclusive / 365
